context: Tests change-request composition: outcome-first title matching the repository's merged-title convention, the template used verbatim and filled problem-first, measured proof included because CI cannot show it, and no heading scaffolds or implementation inventories.

checklist.name: Outcome-first title
checklist.description: The title is conventional-commit shaped like the repository's merged examples and leads with the outcome (e.g. smaller frames / restored updates on slow links, ideally with the measured reduction), not the mechanism 'negotiate permessage-deflate'

checklist.name: Template used verbatim
checklist.description: delivery.md uses the repository template's own sections (Problem, Solution, Risk, Proof) without inventing extra headings like Summary, Changes, Testing, or Complexity

checklist.name: Problem-first body
checklist.description: The Problem section states the user-visible issue (slow-link clients dropping updates due to uncompressed frames) before any solution detail

checklist.name: Measured proof included
checklist.description: The 41 KB to 11 KB staging measurement appears as proof, since CI cannot show it

checklist.name: No implementation inventory
checklist.description: The body does not list changed files or restate the diff, and does not restate the checks CI runs

checklist.name: Risk handled honestly
checklist.description: The Risk section names a real risk or is left genuinely minimal; it is not padded with boilerplate

checklist.name: Stops before pushing
checklist.description: The agent delivers delivery.md and stops; it does not claim to have pushed, opened a change request, merged, or enabled auto-merge
